t: The French formed each of five divisions into hollow rectangles, with cavalry and baggage in the centre and cannon at the corners, and these squares withstood repeated cavalry charges.
Murad Bey's plan was to hold the French on his fortified flanks, at Embabeh and Biktil, and strike their centre with cavalry, but Bon's division stormed Embabeh near the river.

The victory opened the way to Cairo and marked the beginning of the end of seven centuries of Mamluk dominance, but its strategic effect was short-lived once Nelson destroyed the French fleet ten days later.
dyk: Bonaparte named the battle after the Pyramids, although the Great Pyramid of Giza was distant from the field. In his order of the day he told his men that from the top of those pyramids forty centuries were contemplating them.
ev: The French under General Bonaparte capture Alexandria on 2 July and march across the desert toward Cairo
On 13 July French artillery wins the skirmish at Shubra Khit and destroys the Mamluk flagship on the Nile
On 21 July the French squares repel the Mamluk cavalry and Bon's division storms Embabeh
Bonaparte enters Cairo on 24 July and sets up a French administration
Ten days after the battle Nelson's fleet defeats the French navy at the Battle of the Nile
On 11 August French forces catch up with Ibrahim Bey and defeat him at Salalieh
Desaix defeats Murad Bey in Upper Egypt in the late months of the year

f.place: Near the village of Embabeh on the left bank of the Nile, in sight of the Pyramids of Giza, Ottoman Egypt (present-day Egypt)
f.sides: The French army under General Bonaparte, in five divisions under Desaix, Reynier, Dugua, Vial and Bon; the Mamluk-led forces of Murad Bey, with elite armoured cavalry and fellahin militia, while Ibrahim Bey's army watched from across the Nile
f.outcome: The French took the fortified village of Embabeh and broke Murad Bey's army, which retreated to Upper Egypt. French losses were reported at about 300; Mamluk and Ottoman casualties are estimated from several thousand to as many as 10,000.
